Title: KTKHMA10034RN 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 1" Heim Or Uniball For 3/4" Bolt 2-3/4" Stack Height (PAIR)
Body (HTML):
KTK-HMA10034RN

17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 3/4" Heim Or Uniball For 1/2" Bolt 1-13/16" Stack Ht
High misalignment spacers are designed for suspension joints, steering tie rod ends and anything else that uses the pivot of a spherical bearing such as heim joints, rod ends and uniballs. They have two functions. They reduce the hole size to accommodate a smaller bolt and increase the max angle of a spherical bearing.

How much the angle is increased is determined by the bolt size and the amount of material removed. When more material is removed, the strength of the spacer is decreased. The same happens when using a larger bolt. To compensate for this we only use heat treated 17-4 stainless steel for our spacers. This also prevents corrosion when used in everyday applications.

We offer a wide variety of high misalignment spacers for almost every possible application.

Important Notes:
  • Not all spacers will fit every uniball or heim joint. See diagram below regarding uniballs.
  • The stack height or width in the title of the page is a nominal dimension. See below for actual decimal dimension.

Body (HTML):
Speedflow SF383-03 | -3 AN Male to 1/8" NPT Male 90° Adapter | 380 Series

The Speedflow SF383-03 is a precision-machined -3 AN male to 1/8" NPT male 90-degree adapter, part of the Speedflow 380 series AN flare to NPT steel adapter range. The 90° angle allows the -3 AN hose end to exit perpendicular to the NPT port, making it the ideal solution for tight engine bay, caliper, and sensor installations where a straight adapter would force an awkward hose bend.

Product Specifications

  • Part Number: SF383-03
  • AN End: -3 AN male
  • NPT End: 1/8" NPT male
  • Angle: 90 degrees
  • Weight: 22g
  • Series: Speedflow 380 — AN Flare to NPT Steel Adapters
  • Compatible With: Standard -3 AN fittings and 1/8" NPT female ports
  • Barcode: 9342122003042

Applications

The SF383-03 is the go-to choice when a straight AN to NPT adapter won’t provide clean hose routing, including:

  • Brake caliper and master cylinder connections where the line runs parallel to the port face
  • Clutch master and slave cylinder hydraulic line connections in confined spaces
  • Oil pressure gauge and sensor connections on engine blocks and heads
  • Turbo oil feed line connections where a 90° exit eliminates hose stress
  • Fuel pressure gauge and regulator connections requiring a right-angle exit
  • Any -3 AN to 1/8" NPT application where a 90° angle improves routing and reduces hose end stress

90° vs Straight — When to Choose the Angle

A straight AN to NPT adapter works well when the hose approaches the port perpendicularly. However, when the hose runs along the component surface before connecting, a straight adapter forces a sharp bend immediately after the fitting — stressing the hose end and restricting flow. The SF383-03’s 90° angle eliminates this problem, allowing the -3 AN line to exit parallel to the component face for a clean, low-stress routing path. For straight -3 AN to 1/8" NPT applications, see our SF382-03 listing.

AN to NPT — Installation Note

NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT male threads during installation. Do not overtighten — NPT threads can crack cast components if over-torqued.

37° Flare — The AN Standard

The 37° flare is the defining characteristic of the AN (Army-Navy) plumbing standard and is distinct from the 45° flare used in some OEM and SAE applications. The tube nut works by threading onto the male AN fitting and drawing the 37° flared tube end tightly against the fitting’s matching cone seat, creating a reliable metal-to-metal seal without the need for sealants or gaskets. Always ensure your tubing is flared to exactly 37° before assembly — a 45° flare will not seal correctly in an AN fitting.

Title: KTKLS316 Nylon 16 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends ( EACH )
Body (HTML):
Nylon 16 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends
16" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds.

Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent
 damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap.

If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time.

You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail.

Title: KTKHMA7858 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 7/8" Heim Or Uniball For 5/8" Bolt 2-1/8" Stack Height (PAIR)
Body (HTML):
High misalignment spacers are designed for suspension joints, steering tie rod ends and anything else that uses the pivot of a spherical bearing such as heim joints, rod ends and uniballs. They have two functions. They reduce the hole size to accommodate a smaller bolt and increase the max angle of a spherical bearing.

How much the angle is increased is determined by the bolt size and the amount of material removed. When more material is removed, the strength of the spacer is decreased. The same happens when using a larger bolt. To compensate for this we only use heat treated 17-4 stainless steel for our spacers. This also prevents corrosion when used in everyday applications.

We offer a wide variety of high misalignment spacers for almost every possible application.

Important Notes:

  • Not all spacers will fit every uniball or heim joint.
  • The stack height or width in the title of the page is a nominal dimension. See below for actual decimal dimension.

Body (HTML):
Nylon 20 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly End
20" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds.

Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. Chromoly Chrome-Moly Chrome Moly



If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time.

You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail.

Title: KTKHMA3412 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 3/4" Heim Or Uniball For 1/2" Bolt 1-13/16" Stack Ht (PAIR)
Body (HTML):
17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 3/4" Heim Or Uniball For 1/2" Bolt 1-13/16" Stack Ht
High misalignment spacers are designed for suspension joints, steering tie rod ends and anything else that uses the pivot of a spherical bearing such as heim joints, rod ends and uniballs. They have two functions. They reduce the hole size to accommodate a smaller bolt and increase the max angle of a spherical bearing.

How much the angle is increased is determined by the bolt size and the amount of material removed. When more material is removed, the strength of the spacer is decreased. The same happens when using a larger bolt. To compensate for this we only use heat treated 17-4 stainless steel for our spacers. This also prevents corrosion when used in everyday applications.

Title: KTKLS324 Nylon 24 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends
Body (HTML):
Nylon 24 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends
24" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds.

Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. Chromoly Chrome-Moly Chrome Moly



If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time.

You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail.

The Speedflow SF344-03 is a precision-machined -3 AN male to M10 x 1.0 male dual (metric inverted flare) adapter, designed to connect -3 AN braided line systems to components with an M10 x 1.0 metric dual flare port. This adapter is an essential fitting for builders converting Japanese and European OEM brake systems — where M10 x 1.0 metric ports are the dominant standard — to AN-style braided brake lines.

Applications

The SF344-03 is a key adapter for metric brake system AN conversions and custom line fabrication, including:

  • Japanese import, European, and modern Australian vehicle brake line AN conversion builds

Title: 323-04 -4 90 degree bulkhead - steel
Body (HTML):
Speedflow SF323-04 | -4 AN 90° Bulkhead Fitting | Steel

The Speedflow SF323-04 is a precision-machined -4 AN 90-degree bulkhead fitting in steel, designed for routing -4 AN lines through a firewall, chassis panel, or bulkhead where a straight pass-through isn't possible or practical. The 90° angle allows the line to exit the panel parallel to its surface, making it the ideal solution for tight engine bays, transmission tunnels, and firewall installations where space is at a premium and a straight bulkhead would create an awkward hose bend.

Product Specifications

  • Part Number: SF323-04
  • AN Size: -4 AN
  • Angle: 90 degrees
  • Material: Steel
  • Series: Speedflow 323 — Angled Bulkhead Fittings
  • Compatible With: Standard -4 AN flare fittings and hose ends
  • Barcode: 9342122031274

Applications

The SF323-04 is the go-to choice when a straight bulkhead fitting won't provide clean hose routing, including:

  • Firewall brake line pass-throughs where the line runs parallel to the firewall surface
  • Fuel line routing through tight firewall or chassis panel locations
  • Clutch hydraulic line bulkhead installations in confined spaces
  • Oil and coolant line routing through bulkheads in race car and hot rod builds
  • Any -4 AN application where a 90° exit angle eliminates stress on the hose end

90° vs Straight Bulkhead — When to Choose the Angle

A straight bulkhead fitting works well when the line approaches the panel perpendicularly. However, when the line runs along the panel surface before passing through, a straight fitting forces a sharp bend immediately after the bulkhead — stressing the hose end and restricting flow. The SF323-04's 90° angle eliminates this problem entirely, allowing the line to exit parallel to the panel for a clean, low-stress routing path. This is particularly valuable in brake and fuel systems where hose integrity is safety-critical.

For straight -4 AN bulkhead applications, see our SF320-04 listing. Sold individually. Compatible with standard -4 AN flare fittings and hose ends.

Title: 609-00-12-BLK -12 inline scavenge filter black
Body (HTML):
Speedflow 609-00-12-BLK | -12 AN Inline Scavenge Filter | Black | 609 Series

The Speedflow 609-00-12-BLK is a precision-machined -12 AN inline scavenge filter in black anodised finish, part of the Speedflow 609 series coarse screen scavenge filter range. Designed to be installed on dry sump scavenge lines, this filter provides critical protection for the dry sump pump by capturing debris in the event of a major engine failure — preventing catastrophic pump damage and keeping the oiling system intact when it matters most.

Product Specifications

  • Part Number: 609-00-12-BLK
  • AN Size: -12 AN
  • Type: Inline coarse screen scavenge filter
  • Finish: Black anodised
  • Weight: 100g
  • Series: Speedflow 609 — Inline Scavenge Filters

  • Barcode: 9342122017278

Applications

The 609-00-12-BLK is an essential component for dry sump oiling system builds in high-performance and motorsport applications, including:

  • Dry sump scavenge line protection on race engines and high-performance street builds
  • V8 and high-displacement engine dry sump system fabrication
  • Endurance racing and circuit car oiling system builds where engine failure debris protection is critical
  • Any dry sump system where pump protection from catastrophic engine failure debris is required

Why a Scavenge Filter?

In a dry sump oiling system, the scavenge pump draws oil — and potentially debris — directly from the engine sump. In the event of a major engine failure such as a spun bearing, broken ring, or connecting rod failure, large debris particles can be rapidly drawn into the scavenge line. Without a scavenge filter, this debris can destroy the dry sump pump — turning a repairable engine failure into a far more costly total oiling system rebuild.

The Speedflow 609 series coarse screen filter captures this debris inline, protecting the pump and allowing the system to be inspected and cleaned after a failure event. The -12 AN size provides ample flow capacity for high-volume scavenge lines on large-displacement performance engines. The black anodised finish is consistent with a quality race build aesthetic.

Title: KTKLS328 Nylon 28 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH
Body (HTML):
28" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds.

Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap.

If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time.

You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail.

STEEL-IT coatings from Stainless Steel Coatings INC., has been in the business of perfecting their product since 1974. STEEL-IT is applied just like paint, however it contains custom-engineered 316L stainless steel flake for superior protection against corrosion, abrasion, and harsh chemicals. These microscopic 316L flakes tightly overlap to form a neat horizontal layered alignment, forming a metallic barrier film near the coating’s surface that is nearly impervious to corrosion and corrosive elements.

As with all STEEL-IT Brand Coatings, STEEL-IT Polyurethane Aerosol products feature custom-engineered, 316L stainless steel flake and provides superior protection against corrosion, abrasion, salt, alkalis and other chemicals. STEEL-IT Polyurethane withstands high-pressure washdowns and detergents without chipping or flaking, a critical feature in so many applications across industries.

General Purpose Hand Pad 7447 combines flexibility with effective cutting action and precise hand control to accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. Due to its high cut-rate, hardness, strength, and low heat retention, aluminum oxide mineral is widely used in grinding applications in addition to sanding and finishing use. Aluminum oxide is suitable on a wide variety of substrates in both woodworking and metalworking, including ferrous alloys. Our Scotch-Brite™ industrial abrasive products are a unique surface conditioning product with abrasives incorporated into non-woven nylon or other synthetic fibers. Combining abrasives into the fibers creates an abrasive system that delivers consistent results for the life of the product. The open-web material is load resistant and keeps the abrasive minerals cutting at high performance by limiting clogging of the fibers.

The Speedflow 370-04-BLK is a precision-machined -4 AN male to 1/8" NPT female adapter in black anodised finish, designed to connect -4 AN braided line systems to components with a 1/8" NPT (National Pipe Taper) female port. Offering greater flow capacity than the -3 AN SF370-03-BLK variant, the 370-04-BLK is the preferred choice for oil, fuel, turbo, and hydraulic applications where -4 AN line systems interface with 1/8" NPT ported components.

Applications

The 370-04-BLK is a versatile adapter for connecting -4 AN braided lines to NPT-ported components across a wide range of performance builds, including:

  • Turbo oil feed line connections to 1/8" NPT ported turbocharger centre sections
  • Oil pressure gauge and sensor line connections
  • Engine oil and coolant line connections to NPT-ported components
  • Fuel pressure gauge and regulator connections
  • Hydraulic line connections to 1/8" NPT ported valves and sensors
  • Any application requiring a -4 AN to 1/8" NPT interface in a performance or race build

370-04 vs 370-03 — Choosing the Right Size

The Speedflow 370 series AN to NPT adapters are available in both -3 AN (SF370-03-BLK) and -4 AN (370-04-BLK) configurations. The -4 AN variant provides a larger internal bore for increased fluid flow, making it the better choice for turbo oil feeds, fuel lines, and other high-flow applications. For lower-flow applications such as oil pressure sensors and gauge lines, the -3 AN SF370-03-BLK is typically sufficient.

AN to NPT — Installation Note

NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT threads during installation to ensure a leak-free seal. The black anodised finish delivers a premium aesthetic suited to show-quality and race builds alike.

Understanding Power Valves:

  • Function: Adds fuel to the main circuit when engine vacuum drops below the valve's rating
  • Vacuum Rating: The point (in inches of mercury) at which the valve opens
  • Selection Rule: Typically use a valve rated at half your idle vacuum reading
  • Common Ratings: Range from 2.5 to 10.5 in. Hg for different applications
  • 4.5 Rating: Ideal for engines with 9-10 in. Hg idle vacuum (moderate to aggressive cams)

  • Performance engines with moderate to aggressive camshafts

  • When changing camshafts or engine modifications affect idle vacuum
  • If fuel leaks from the power valve area
  • If current power valve rating is too high for lower-vacuum engine

Selection Tips:

  • Measure idle vacuum with engine fully warmed and in gear (automatic) or neutral (manual)
  • Divide idle vacuum reading by 2 to determine proper power valve rating
  • Example: 9 in. Hg idle vacuum ÷ 2 = 4.5 in. Hg power valve
  • Lower vacuum engines (moderate to big cams) need lower-rated valves (2.5-4.5 in. Hg)
  • Using too high a rating on lower-vacuum engines causes rich idle and poor fuel economy

Holley Single-Stage Power Valve - Part #125-25

Ensure optimal fuel enrichment during acceleration with this genuine Holley 2.5 in. Hg power valve. This critical component operates vacuum-controlled enrichment in your carburetor's power circuit, opening at 2.5 inches of mercury to deliver additional fuel during heavy acceleration and full-throttle operation, preventing lean conditions and hesitation. Designed specifically for low-vacuum, high-performance engines with aggressive camshafts. Includes gasket for complete installation.

What's Included:

Key Features:

  • 2.5 in. Hg Rating: Opens at 2.5 inches of mercury vacuum for low-vacuum engine applications
  • Single-Stage Design: Standard flow for high-performance applications

  • Genuine Holley Quality: OEM-grade component for reliable performance
  • Standard Flow: Balanced enrichment for aggressive performance engines

Performance Benefits:

  • Prevents lean conditions during acceleration and heavy load
  • Eliminates hesitation and bogging under throttle
  • Provides smooth, consistent power delivery
  • Automatically enriches fuel mixture when engine vacuum drops
  • Essential for proper carburetor performance on aggressive cam engines
  • Prevents power valve from opening at idle on low-vacuum engines

Understanding Power Valves:

  • Function: Adds fuel to the main circuit when engine vacuum drops below the valve's rating
  • Vacuum Rating: The point (in inches of mercury) at which the valve opens
  • Selection Rule: Typically use a valve rated at half your idle vacuum reading
  • Common Ratings: Range from 2.5 to 10.5 in. Hg for different applications
  • 2.5 Rating: Lowest common rating for engines with 5-6 in. Hg idle vacuum (aggressive cams, racing)

Ideal Applications:

  • High-performance engines with aggressive camshafts and low idle vacuum
  • Racing engines with 5-6 in. Hg idle vacuum (use half of idle vacuum)
  • Street/strip combinations with radical camshafts
  • Engines with significant valve overlap and low manifold vacuum
  • Replacing failed or damaged power valves
  • Carburetor rebuilds on high-performance engines

When to Replace:

  • During carburetor rebuild or overhaul
  • If experiencing hesitation or stumbling during acceleration
  • After engine backfire (can rupture power valve diaphragm)
  • When changing camshafts or engine modifications affect idle vacuum
  • If fuel leaks from the power valve area
  • If current power valve rating is too high for low-vacuum engine

Selection Tips:

  • Measure idle vacuum with engine fully warmed and in gear (automatic) or neutral (manual)
  • Divide idle vacuum reading by 2 to determine proper power valve rating
  • Example: 5 in. Hg idle vacuum ÷ 2 = 2.5 in. Hg power valve
  • Very low vacuum engines (big cams, racing) need lowest-rated valves (2.5-3.5 in. Hg)
  • Using too high a rating on low-vacuum engines causes rich idle and poor fuel economy
  • 2.5 in. Hg is the lowest common rating available

Ensure optimal fuel enrichment during acceleration with this genuine Holley 6.5 in. Hg power valve. This critical component operates vacuum-controlled enrichment in your carburetor's power circuit, opening at 6.5 inches of mercury to deliver additional fuel during heavy acceleration and full-throttle operation, preventing lean conditions and hesitation.

Key Features:

  • 6.5 in. Hg Rating: Opens at 6.5 inches of mercury vacuum for precise enrichment timing
  • Single-Stage Design: Standard flow for most street performance applications
  • Vacuum Operated: Automatically responds to engine load conditions
  • Genuine Holley Quality: OEM-grade component for reliable performance
  • Standard Flow: Balanced enrichment for typical performance engines
  • Direct Replacement: Fits all Holley carburetors with power valve circuits

Performance Benefits:

  • Prevents lean conditions during acceleration and heavy load
  • Eliminates hesitation and bogging under throttle
  • Provides smooth, consistent power delivery
  • Automatically enriches fuel mixture when engine vacuum drops
  • Essential for proper carburetor performance and engine protection

Understanding Power Valves:

  • Function: Adds fuel to the main circuit when engine vacuum drops below the valve's rating
  • Vacuum Rating: The point (in inches of mercury) at which the valve opens
  • Selection Rule: Typically use a valve rated at half your idle vacuum reading
  • Common Ratings: Range from 2.5 to 10.5 in. Hg for different applications
  • 6.5 Rating: Most common for street engines with 13-14 in. Hg idle vacuum

Ideal Applications:

  • Street performance engines with moderate camshafts
  • Engines with 13-14 in. Hg idle vacuum (use half of idle vacuum)
  • Replacing failed or damaged power valves
  • Carburetor rebuilds and overhauls
  • Troubleshooting lean acceleration conditions
  • Most stock and mild performance street applications

When to Replace:

  • During carburetor rebuild or overhaul
  • If experiencing hesitation or stumbling during acceleration
  • After engine backfire (can rupture power valve diaphragm)
  • When changing camshafts or engine modifications affect idle vacuum
  • If fuel leaks from the power valve area
  • As preventive maintenance during carburetor service

Selection Tips:

  • Measure idle vacuum with engine fully warmed and in gear (automatic) or neutral (manual)
  • Divide idle vacuum reading by 2 to determine proper power valve rating
  • Example: 13 in. Hg idle vacuum ÷ 2 = 6.5 in. Hg power valve
  • Lower vacuum engines (big cams) need lower-rated valves (3.5-4.5 in. Hg)
  • Higher vacuum engines may use higher-rated valves (8.5-10.5 in. Hg)
